changelog: 1.11.0 (2026-07-14): User relaxed Rule 46c R:R floors. Standard 1.5->1.2 (phase_d.gate_46c.rr_minimum_threshold + phase_c.ut_relax.relax_1.rr_floor_standard); uptrend/relaxed 1.2->1.1 (phase_d.gate_46c.rr_minimum_threshold_uptrend NEW + phase_c.ut_relax.relax_1.rr_floor_relaxed). LOOSENING — candidates pass 46c with less headroom to nearest_unbroken_resistance; more thin-reward setups become buyable. Downside gates (77/78/26e/77c) unchanged. Heuristic, not backtested.

1.10.0 (2026-07-14): User raised phase_d.gate_sub_26f.climax_single_session_pct 10->25. One-bar-climax exhaustion gate now fires only on a >=25% single-session spike + volume collapse. LOOSENING — 10-24% single-day pops no longer auto-fail Sub-26f at Phase D. Phase C RM-9 screen (momentum_climax_single_move_pct) and RM-7 (rm7.climax_move_pct) left at 10. Heuristic, not backtested.

1.9.0 (2026-07-14): Rule 46d fresh-high exemption basis lowered from 52-week high to 14-week high (~70 sessions) per user. New keys phase_d.gate_46d.fresh_high_basis='14week', fresh_high_lookback_sessions=70, close_to_fresh_high_max_pct=1.5. measured_move_target now projects from the 14wH. LOOSENING: more breakouts skip the 46c R:R gate; 46c nearest_unbroken_resistance still guards non-46d candidates and can still find supply between the 14wH and 52wH. Downside gate 77c UNCHANGED (still 52wH). close_to_52wh_max_pct retained for back-compat/77c reference. ALSO extracted remaining hardcoded gate literals to config: gate_46c.fifty_two_week_high_lookback_sessions=252 + resistance_round_number_multiples=[50,100,500] (were bare literals in chart-gates prose); added phase_d._fresh_high_bases central week->session mapping (52w=252, 14w=70). chart-gates SKILL.md resistance-builder + 46d prose now reference config keys, never hard-code.

1.8.0 (2026-07-14): Added phase_b.news_sources (9-source roster with id/name/url/method/rss/status) and phase_b.news_source_health (dead-source auto-removal thresholds). Sources 7->9: +Google News India RSS (verified) +MSN India (weak, JS-rendered). news_source_count 7->9. Dead-source policy: >=3 consecutive access failures -> DEAD/skip, floor of 4 active, env-block guard at 0.8 fraction. Runtime counters in data/news_sources_health.json. User request. Origin: HCLTECH 2026-07-14 company-news miss + 'remove channels that reject feed access multiple times'.

1.7.0 (2026-07-13): Added phase_c.rsi_reversion.reversal_pending_watchlist (RSI-REV trend-only rejects carried 3 sessions). ALSO added phase_b.share_sale_overhang — codifies the SHARE_SALE_OVERHANG lift condition and CORRECTS it: the original Jul 7 rule required reclaiming the pre-announcement high on 1.5x vol (too late — reversal already played out); corrected to lift on the FIRST confirmed trend reversal (UT-1 flips up OR Rule 77 clears), not on a high-reclaim. User correction 2026-07-13. Origin: ATHERENERG Rs1900cr share sale.

1.6.0 (2026-07-10): Removed Gate B (trend change confirmed) and Gate D (volatility floor) from phase_d.hard_gate_3_1. Eval universe is sourced from market movers so these gates are redundant. Removed keys: reversal_confirmation_sessions, sideways_duration_sessions from hard_gate_3_1.

1.5.0 (2026-07-10): RSI-REV entry changed from state (rsi<=50 any day) to CROSS-UP event (prev session <=50 AND current >50). Key renamed buy_rsi_max -> buy_rsi_cross, added entry_mode=cross_up_through_50. Re-backtest 1yr: state=100%/43-of-43 perfect vs cross_up=95.4%/35-of-43 perfect (175 trades, 167 wins; ATHER +58.9% vs +77.7%). User chose cross_up for safer entry (never buys deep at RSI 33 on the way down) despite lower win rate. Both backtests retained (_backtest_crossup + _backtest). Still REVIEW status.

1.4.0 (2026-07-10): Added phase_c.rsi_reversion (Rule RSI-REV). 43-symbol basket where RSI-14<=50 ALWAYS adds the stock to the candidate list as an RSI-Reversion buy (exit RSI>=65), then a downtrend gate (Rule 77 / UT-1 DOWN) may REJECT it — never a silent drop. Basket + 100%-win-rate backtest (1yr 2025-07-09..2026-07-09, no costs) derived from scripts scan; empirical caveat recorded (bull-year regime + selection bias + small trade counts). Also flipped the 43 basket symbols to active:true in basestock.json under anchor group rsi_reversion_basket_2026_07_10.

1.3.0 (2026-07-10): chartink.scan_clause_t1 (A.0) collapsed onto the `latest close` clause (identical to scan_clause_t0). Removes the two-day-lookback T-1 filter `1 day ago close > 2 days ago close * 1.05`. Chartink `latest` decides the session (T-0 open / T-1 closed), so qualifying gain and reported pct_chg are now the same day — fixes negative-pct_chg entries in dailygainers.csv. Tag/collision contracts unchanged.

1.2.0 (2026-07-09): Refit phase_c.rm12. Backtest raised RM-12 win rate 60.7%->83.3% (adx_14>=30 + roc_10>=0 were the killer filters; rsi tightened 35-72 -> 48-65). Details in phase_c.rm12._refit. Wider alternate at 75%/16 trades documented.

1.1.0 (2026-07-09): Refit phase_c.rule80 and phase_c.rm4 (+ phase_f.pattern_attribution mirrors). Backtest on 2026-04-08..2026-07-09 raised R-80 win rate 45.9%->81.25% (atr_pct<=3.5 was the killer filter) and RM-4 54.1%->80.0% (cmf_20>=-0.05 + adx>=15). Details in each block's _refit sub-object.
1.0.0 (2026-07-04): Initial extraction from inline skill/agent constants.
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for all tunable thresholds, weights, and caps in the india-stock-recommender pipeline. Anchored to pre-Jul-4 2026 live behavior — no Day-1 behavioral change on extraction.
invariants: Change values here; NEVER hard-code the same number in a skill file.
Every skill loads config.json once at start of its run and passes the dict to shards as read-only input.
Weight refits (once ~60 sessions of realized outcomes accumulate) rewrite ONLY scoring.* keys, atomically.
Numeric values only. String constants that are enums (e.g. UT-1 state names) are also here; free-form narrative is not.

share_sale_overhang.trend_reversal_confirmed_def: UT-1 flips from DOWN/SIDEWAYS to UP or STRONG_UP (pivot HL + MA5>MA20 turning up) OR Rule 77 confirmed-downtrend clears (LH/LL below threshold), on the FIRST such session — do NOT wait for a reclaim of the pre-announcement high.
share_sale_overhang.placement_priced_or_cleared_def: share-sale/QIP/OFS/block price disclosed AND placement window closed or block deal reported done (news-confirmed). If placement status is unknown, trend_reversal_confirmed alone MAY lift to REVERSAL_PENDING watchlist entry (not a full buy) so the turn is not missed.
share_sale_overhang.note: 2026-07-13 user correction. ORIGINAL Jul 7 lift condition required 'close reclaims pre-announcement high on vol >=1.5x' — that is TOO LATE: by the time a stock reclaims its old high the reversal has already played out and the entry is missed (same class as the RSI-REV/GOCOLORS/STLTECH late-framing fixes). Corrected: buy on the FIRST trend reversal after the overhang, not after a fresh/old high is reclaimed. The 3-5 week supply-digestion window is context, NOT a wait-gate. Origin: ATHERENERG Rs1900cr share sale announced Jul 7 2026.

_refit.note: Key differentiator: cmf_20 >= -0.05 (money flow floor) + adx_14 >= 15 pushed win rate from 54% to 80%. Kept baseline rsi/dip/vol bands; rsi_max raised 58->60 during grid but 45-60 was winner. See scripts/refit_r80_rm4_v2.py.

Two killer filters: adx_14 >= 30 (was ≥20 via slope-only; stronger trend distinguishes real pullbacks) + roc_10 >= 0 (10-day momentum non-negative proves the pullback has stalled, not still falling). Also tightened rsi 35-72 -> 48-65. Sweep saturated at 61.5% with only baseline filters; the momentum-turn signals (roc_10/adx) were the discriminator. See scripts/refit_rm12.py + refit_rm12_v2.py. Alternate wider-net config: rsi 45-68 -> 75.0% wr / 16 trades / avg +4.01%.

rsi_reversion._doc: Rule RSI-REV (2026-07-10, user request; entry revised 2026-07-10 to cross-up). For symbols in `basket`, on the day daily rsi_wilder_14 CROSSES UP through 50 (prior session <= 50 AND current session > 50), ALWAYS add the stock to the candidate list as an RSI-Reversion BUY with exit target rsi_wilder_14 >= sell_rsi_min. This is a CROSS-UP EVENT, not a state — a stock that has been sitting below 50 for days does NOT re-trigger; it triggers only on the session RSI first pokes back above 50 (the bounce starting). The candidate is then subject to `reject_gates` — if any fires it is REJECTED (surfaced in STOCKS CARRIED FORWARD with the rejection reason), NEVER silently dropped. Signal is watchlist/aggressive tier — it does NOT bypass downside gates.
rsi_reversion.entry_mode_note: cross_up_through_50 = trigger when prev_session_rsi <= buy_rsi_cross AND current_session_rsi > buy_rsi_cross. Deliberately NOT a `rsi <= 50` state trigger (that was the original 2026-07-10 spec, backtested at 100% win but it entered deep — e.g. SCI at RSI 33 — and buys on the way down). Cross-up waits for the bounce to actually begin. Re-backtest (below) showed state=100%/43-perfect vs cross_up=95.4%/35-perfect; user chose cross_up for the safer entry despite lower win rate/returns.
rsi_reversion.reject_gate_note: RSI-REV can only be REJECTED by a downside gate, never upgraded past conf_cap. Rule 77 (3+LH/2+LL confirmed downtrend) and UT-1 DOWN are the primary rejecters — even after a cross-up through 50, if the stock is still in a confirmed downtrend the bounce is treated as a dead-cat and rejected.

reversal_pending_watchlist.reentry_trigger: Rule 77 clears (LH/LL count below threshold) OR UT-1 flips to SIDEWAYS/UP, AND current close RSI still > 50
reversal_pending_watchlist.note: 2026-07-13 user-requested. A cross-up-through-50 RSI-REV name rejected ONLY by a trend-not-yet-confirmed gate (one of trigger_gates) has already turned its RSI up; it is blocked purely because the trend has not confirmed. Instead of dropping it, carry it on the published WATCHLIST as watchlist_status=REVERSAL_PENDING for up to max_sessions_carried sessions, with reentry_trigger. Auto-drop when sessions exceeded OR RSI closes < drop_rsi (bounce failed). Structural rejects (RSI-REV_REJECT_CLIMAX/_DISTRIBUTION/_BE) are NOT carried — those signal the bounce itself is unsafe, not merely unconfirmed. Origin: BIOCON/JAYNECOIND/KEI Jul 13 crossed RSI 50 up, all rejected by Rule 77, silently dropped from actionable watchlist.

rsi_reversion.target_price_estimate_note: Suggested target = the price at which rsi_wilder_14 would reach sell_rsi_min, estimated from current RSI, current close, and ATR-14 (approx: price move needed to lift 14-period Wilder RSI from current to 65). Report as an estimate, not a hard level.

_backtest_crossup.rule: buy on session rsi crosses UP through 50 (prev<=50 and today>50), sell rsi>=65
_backtest_crossup.vs_state_entry: state (rsi<=50 any day) scored 100.0% / 43-of-43 perfect / ATHER +77.7%. Cross-up is safer (no deep entries) but 8 trades flip to losers.
_backtest_crossup.CAVEAT: Still a bull-year + selection-bias result: basket chosen because it won in-sample under the state definition, most names have few trades. Cross-up is more realistic but 95.4% is NOT proven edge. Re-validate out-of-sample / non-bull regime before promoting from REVIEW.

_backtest.selection: 43 symbols that showed 100% win-rate with >=3 completed trades in-window; scanned 425 symbols, 115 qualified
_backtest.CAVEAT: 100% win-rate is a BULL-YEAR + SELECTION-BIAS artifact: (1) the window was a broad up-market; (2) basket was chosen BECAUSE it won in-sample (survivorship); (3) most names have only 3-6 trades — statistically thin; (4) the rule UNDERPERFORMED buy&hold on strong trenders (ATHERENERG +262% held vs +78% traded). Treat as capital-efficiency signal, NOT proven edge. Do NOT re-affirm without out-of-sample / non-bull-regime validation.

chartink.scan_clause_t1: ( {cash} ( latest close > 1 day ago close * 1.05 and latest close * latest volume > 10000000 ) )
chartink.scan_clause_t0: ( {cash} ( latest close > 1 day ago close * 1.05 and latest close * latest volume > 10000000 ) )
chartink._scan_clause_note: 2026-07-10: A.0 (scan_clause_t1) switched from the two-day-lookback clause to the same `latest close` clause as F.1 (scan_clause_t0). Chartink `latest` resolves to the last completed session — T-0 when market open, T-1 when closed — so the scanner decides the date. This makes the qualifying gain and the reported pct_chg the SAME session (fixes the negative-pct_chg display artifact where a T-1 qualifier showed a T-0 quote). A.0 still tags its rows t1_5pct_liq1cr on the resolved date; F.1 still tags t0_5pct_liq1cr on T-0; collision guards unchanged.
